goalSummary: The performance dashboard's distribution charts show only central/average values, with no visible fastest or slowest turn data points for a run.

facts.why: The exact file implementing head+tail sampling logic must be identified
The specific time-window bounds used before head/tail selection must be documented
The existing time-windowed aggregation function complemented by head+tail sampling must be named
The trigger point for foreground measurement at run close must be documented
Fix: the span window filter must be applied before head/tail selection to avoid cross-span boundary contamination
